DejaVu Sans Mono — bundled test fixture for nbs-term render-state harness
==========================================================================

Files: DejaVuSansMono.ttf, DejaVuSansMono-Bold.ttf, DejaVuSansMono-Oblique.ttf,
       DejaVuSansMono-BoldOblique.ttf

Family: DejaVu Sans Mono
Source: https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/

License: Bitstream Vera Fonts Copyright + DejaVu changes Public Domain /
         Bitstream Vera License — see Bitstream Vera Copyright notice
         and DejaVu Fonts Copyright at the upstream project.

Bundled here under the original Bitstream Vera permission to redistribute
the font files with or without modifications, provided the copyright
notices accompany them. These files are unmodified copies.

This fixture exists ONLY to make tests/test_render_state golden output
deterministic across developer machines + CI by pinning the font family
+ rasterizer-input metrics. Production p3_pty does NOT bundle or load
these files; production resolves font_normal via Tk's TkFixedFont alias
against the host's installed monospace family.
